newsitem.title: UK: DSL Bank eyes $500 mln Eurobond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: DSL Bank eyes $500 mln Eurobond - dealers.

text.p: Deutsche Siedlungs-und Landesrentenbank (DSL Bank) is expected to launch a dollar Eurobond this week, syndicate managers said on Tuesday.
The amount is likely to be around $500 million with a five-year maturity, they said.
Dealers said the bond was likely to be priced around 11 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
Merrill Lynch and Nomura were tipped as joint lead managers for the transaction.
DSL Bank last launched a dollar Eurobond -- a $300 million four-year offering -- on January 16 via Nomura. The paper was launched at 12 b.p. over U.S. Treasuries.
The borrower is rated triple-A by Moody's Investors Service and Standard & Poor's Corp.
